title: Ant Group's Bailing team has released Ling-3.1-flash, an open-source AI model with about 560 billion parameters and support for very long documents.
source_used: KuCoin News, citing Ant Group's Bailing team
key_facts: Ant Group's Bailing (written Bailin in the article) open-sourced Ling-3.1-flash
About 560B total parameters, about 25B active per token, 1 million token context
Artificial Analysis intelligence score 41, output about 210 tokens per second
Compression cut weights from about 534 GB to 292 GB; deployment from 8 to 4 Hopper GPUs
First token in 604 ms on 8 GPUs in simulated production tests
About 1.36 QPS on 4 GPUs under stated latency limits
Limited-time 2.5x discount on the online service
quote_evidence: Ling-3.1-flash has approximately 560 billion total parameters, activates about 25 billion parameters per token, and supports a maximum context length of 1 million.
In the public evaluation by Artificial Analysis, Ling-3.1-flash has an intelligence score of 41 and an output speed of approximately 210 tokens per second.
On the corresponding Hopper GPU test configuration, service deployment was reduced from 8 GPUs to 4 GPUs
why_it_matters_hint: Fewer chips needed to self-host a large long-context model.
notes: KuCoin flash article, which relays the team's announcement; the original announcement was not read. Article says 'yesterday', published 16 Oct 00:59 UTC.
